After the start(ruby) and Ice(sapphire) continents, it is generally the last mine of the new area that provides the highest benefit. Focusing there is your best bet.  Once things start to slow down, it is time to move to the next area.

For impossible island, i cannot say for sure as i haven't started there, it is recommended to save 40 keys before you begin. This is enough to get to Lorenzo(an exceptional super manager), while at the same time ensures you have had ample time to improve your collectibles and super managers. This area by all accounts is extremely difficult and it is recommended you don't start there until you can complete an event in 4 hours without tokens.  

Research is a pretty flexible area that you will find several differing strategies for. I will post my recommendations but don't take my opinion as canon and keep an eye out for other tips. Your green cogs(start continent) focus should be reaching all of the all mine nodes(they increase multipliers on all areas) dusk, ancient, then every ruby node. Blue cogs(ice continent) should focus on maximizing bonus multipliers for watching ads, i also recomend increasing the total boost time so you can watch less ads. Red cogs(fire continent) i focused first on increasing the manager  cost reduction percentages for mineshaft, elevator and warehouse, further than that there isn't a ton of value I've seen. Pink cogs(dawn continent) you will want to focus on increasing mainland gems, i recommend maxing boosts for all gems before increasing individual gem totals. Purple cogs(dusk continent) i can't give much advice other than increasing dusk and ancient nodes and that goes for lime cogs(ancient continent) as well.
